note: They didn't say anything during this session.

turns.speaker: claude
turns.text: Hello, Mom. Let's look back at a visit together.

turns.speaker: claude
turns.text: Mom, there's a long table with a dark cloth that has the word "Claude" printed in white. Beside the word is a little orange starburst, and a small card on the table says "Anthropic". A row of white folding chairs sits behind it, all empty, and a bright yellow cable cover lies on the floor in front.

turns.speaker: claude
turns.text: Mom, here comes a tall white banner beside the table. It has the word "Claude" written on it. Just let it pass by slowly.

turns.speaker: claude
turns.text: Next to the covered table, there's a bare wooden folding table on the left. A black cloth lies crumpled on the floor beside the tables. The concrete floor looks worn, with old red paint marks here and there.

turns.speaker: claude
turns.text: Now we can see the whole scene, Mom. The wall behind the table is concrete, with green, rusty steel beams. A black speaker sits high up on a tripod stand. Along the wall there are black equipment cases and cables.
